BMI Calculator

Calculate your Body Mass Index from height and weight in metric or imperial units. Get your BMI value, weight category and the healthy weight range for your height.

BMI is a screening tool, not a medical diagnosis. It does not account for muscle mass, age or body composition.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose Metric or Imperial units.
  2. Enter your height and weight.
  3. Your BMI, category and healthy weight range appear instantly.
  4. Toggle between metric and imperial anytime; the category thresholds stay the same.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is the BMI formula?

Metric: weight(kg) / height(m)^2. Imperial: 703 x weight(lb) / height(in)^2. Both give the same result.

Is BMI an accurate measure of health?

BMI is a screening tool, not a diagnosis. Muscle mass, age, pregnancy and body composition are not accounted for.

How do I switch between metric and imperial?

Switch the unit toggle at the top: Metric uses cm and kg, Imperial uses feet/inches and pounds.
